attempts.prompt:
Static camera, closer shot of the wooden counter top of an inn front desk. The camera is fixed on a tripod and never moves for the whole eight seconds: no pan, no truck, no dolly, no tilt, no zoom, no reframing, no cuts. The first frame and the last frame have exactly the same framing. Preserve the supplied starting frame exactly: the worn wooden counter, the stack of blank white registration cards, the pen, the jar of daffodils, the laptop, the beige desk phone, the innkeeper seated behind the counter in an olive-green cardigan, daylight.

For the first second nothing moves. Then the innkeeper lowers the key to the counter, reaches across with one hand, takes one blank card from the stack, slides it and the pen across the counter toward camera, lets go, and draws her hand back. The blank card and pen rest on the counter for the rest of the shot.

The card is blank with no writing. Her face stays out of frame above the top edge. No new person, prop, text, logo or sound. Real-time motion.
